name: T24 — first event for a key (no stored version) → apply
reason: No prior version on record; any versioned event is accepted

name: T24 — incoming version strictly greater than stored → apply
reason: Monotonically increasing: 6 > 5, apply and update stored to 6

name: T24 — incoming version equal to stored → skip (idempotent duplicate)
reason: Duplicate delivery (Kafka at-least-once); equal version is idempotent → skip

name: T24 — incoming version less than stored → skip (out-of-order event)
reason: Stale Kafka event arrived out of order; 3 <= 10 → skip to prevent regression

name: T24 — version absent (null) → apply + warn once (legacy Role Service)
reason: Older Role Service that does not yet emit version numbers; backward-compat: apply the event but emit a one-time warning

name: T24 — version absent repeated → apply without additional warnings (warn-once)
reason: Second (and subsequent) unversioned events must not re-fire the warning; warn-once per VersionStore instance

name: T24 — DELETE_ROLE clears stored version; re-add with lower version accepted
reason: DELETE_ROLE removes the version entry so a subsequent re-add is not blocked by the deleted role's stale version
